description: Review-fix pass: remove loginWithOAuth, fix OTP session conflict, extract shared login hook, optimize profile+role query, fix manager access to settings
steps: 1. Remove loginWithOAuth from AuthContext interface and provider
2. Fix OTP session conflict by using updateUser instead of signInWithOtp
4. Update Login.tsx and StaffLogin.tsx to use shared hook
5. Optimize profile+role query with a single join
6. Remove Settings from manager role's sectionsByRole
8. Add social OAuth buttons (Google, Facebook, Microsoft, Twitter) to Login page
acceptance_criteria: pnpm build passes with zero TypeScript errors
loginWithOAuth removed from AuthContext interface and provider
OTP page uses updateUser instead of signInWithOtp
Shared useLoginForm hook exists and is used by both login pages
Single query for profile+role in AuthContext
Manager role does not see Settings in sidebar
Manager role is blocked from /settings routes
Login page has social OAuth buttons for Google, Facebook, Microsoft, Twitter
verification: Run `pnpm build` and confirm zero errors and successful bundle output
findings: All fixes applied successfully. Build passes cleanly with zero TypeScript errors. Used underscore prefix for destructured `_roles` variable to satisfy noUnusedLocals. Social OAuth uses supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth directly in the Login component rather than through AuthContext.
